mapper.select: SELECT p.client_id, p.belong_group_client_id, p.risk_control_industry_classify, p.is_related FROM corp_commerce_info_lib p INNER JOIN (SELECT main_id AS client_id, MAX(version) AS version FROM common_version t1 WHERE t1.module = 'CLIENT' AND t1.version_type = 1 GROUP BY main_id) m ON p.client_id = m.client_id AND p.version = m.version where p.risk_control_industry_classify = 'INTRA_GROUP_COLLABORATION'
